endorsements.quote: However, well-designed pragmatic RCTs evidencing the benefit of an intervention are the only acceptable justification for the deployment of such influential applications, provided ethical concerns surrounding implementation are addressed.

unlisted_practices: Design pragmatic trials of LLM interventions around how LLMs will be implemented in clinical workflows rather than repurposing existing material as a benchmark.
Focus AI development on improving specific aspects of health care rather than attaining higher performance on arbitrary benchmarks.
Do not treat medical examination performance or unvalidated surrogate variables as evidence of an LLM's clinical aptitude or safety.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint article discussing evidence requirements, validation rigor, and evaluation methodologies needed before deploying clinical LLMs.
